story.titleZh: 法拉利车队希望延续上次赛事的强劲表现
story.summaryZh: 法拉利车队表示希望延续上次赛事的强劲表现，并在本周末继续展现实力。
story.originalTitle: 🗣️ “I’m hoping we can continue the strong performance we had last time out and bring it into this weekend.”
story.summaryEn: 🗣️ “I’m hoping we can continue the strong performance we had last time out and bring it into this weekend.”

relatedItems.originalTitle: Charles currently sits P2 halfway through Q2, while Lewis hasn’t set a lap time after aborting his first run
relatedItems.summaryEn: Charles currently sits P2 halfway through Q2, while Lewis hasn’t set a lap time after aborting his first run
detailZh: 查尔斯目前在Q2进行到一半时坐在P2位置，而刘易斯在第一次尝试后放弃后还没有设置圈速
detailEn: Charles currently sits P2 halfway through Q2, while Lewis hasn’t set a lap time after aborting his first run
